finding.summary: Multiple ARCHITECTURE_DELTA_BATCH_JSON envelopes in one worker output can claim the same historical source/chunk/extraction_pass. All flattened proposals are checked and inserted before the first envelope advances historical_chunks.extraction_passes, so more than one same-pass envelope can admit candidates even though progress advances once.
finding.impact: Candidate/evidence-funnel inflation and ambiguous per-pass provenance; no canonical truth minting is claimed.
finding.hypothesis: A versioned unique extraction-admission identity keyed by canonical chunk_id plus extraction_pass, with source_event_id binding and atomic envelope-plus-delta admission, will make one canonical extraction pass admit at most one envelope while preserving replay idempotence.
finding.counterhypothesis: The model-output contract requiring one envelope is sufficient and duplicate same-pass envelopes are harmless.
finding.discriminator: A deterministic fixture with two valid same-pass envelopes must currently be able to admit candidates from both while progress advances once; the repaired path must admit candidates from exactly one envelope and make replay plus zero.

external_prior_art.principle: UNIQUE/PRIMARY KEY conflict targets plus serialized writes can enforce deterministic one-row admission; this is a design input, not Clay runtime evidence.
